subject: exp-dym
title: EXP.DYM.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 470 (MP(I)-44). EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition), AFI (affinity insight) and CULT-INFO-BS (culture information basis). From TRS: A-PR (all-purpose). From AFI: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From CULT-INFO-BS: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and PART (participation). From IF-ST-DY: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From PART: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies).
